title: Assemble degree-zero continuity into three cochain terms
statement: Under the common-base continuity hypotheses, for a finite split hypercover V at a stage i and q≥0, there exist the diagram of three-term section complexes of its later-stage pullbacks, object identifications with the actual section short complexes, and the canonical cocone with legs tailCochainMap to its limit pullback. Each of its three termwise evaluated cocones is colimiting.

source.place: Detailed proof, paragraph 2: finite skeleton descent and finite-cochain section continuity; explicit categorical construction with Grothendieck coefficients.

external.place: Tag 09YQ, degree zero (abelian coefficients); arbitrary Grothendieck coefficients by the categorical finite-matching argument stated in the proof

proof.text: Precompose each presheaf in the normalized relative section diagram by the hypercover simplicial object, apply alternating cofaces, and take the three-term short complex at q. Functoriality transports the object isomorphisms and the cocone. Evaluation in each of the three terms is definitionally evaluation at the corresponding hypercover degree. The finite truncation and splitting cofan identify each hypercover term with a finite coproduct of qcqs nondegenerate constituents, hence it is qcqs. Apply degree-zero continuity at these three objects. The mapped tail comparison agrees with tailCochainMap by associativity of the unit, coefficient and restriction factors. This also covers the repeated degree-zero predecessor term.

theorem exists_tail_section_shortComplex_colimit
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology A)
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g).left]
    (c : Cone D) [CompactSpace c.pt.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace c.pt.left]
    (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c)) (q : ℕ) (i : I)
    (V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover (D.obj i).left) :
    ∃ (K : (Over i)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ShortComplex A)
      (e : ∀ j, K.obj j ≅ sectionShortComplex A
        ((Etale.upperStar A (D.obj j.unop.left).hom).obj F)
        (tailHypercover D i V j.unop) q)
      (ν : K ⟶ (Functor.const (Over i)ᵒᵖ).obj
        (sectionShortComplex A ((Etale.upperStar A c.pt.hom).obj F)
          (V.baseChange (coneProjection D c i)) q)),
      (∀ j, ν.app j = (e j).hom ≫ tailCochainMap A D c F q i V j.unop) ∧
        Nonempty (IsColimit (ShortComplex.π₁.mapCocone (Cocone.mk _ ν))) ∧
        Nonempty (IsColimit (ShortComplex.π₂.mapCocone (Cocone.mk _ ν))) ∧
        Nonempty (IsColimit (ShortComplex.π₃.mapCocone (Cocone.mk _ ν)))
